reviewed_high_value_regions.note: Broad and orthogonal recall converge on pre-existing cohort heterogeneity exposed by deleveraging and late-period small-bank market-discipline shocks. Wholesale funding and shadow-asset complexity are strategy/risk dimensions rather than a second period-wide rural-bank model; provincial-union support and recognition changes are cross-cutting mechanisms; village banks remain a smaller sponsor-led parallel lineage; internet/digital deposits are an emerging funding technique rather than a new lineage.

Broad recall is materially novel. It adds a funding-geography dimension around internet/off-site deposits, sponsor/shareholder control, depositor confidence, provincial support/resolution, pandemic forbearance-recognition timing and strong-county counterexamples. These remain MEMORY_LEADS_ONLY and do not establish a new BANK-RURAL lineage. One independent same-slice orthogonal challenge is required before advancing.

known_major_gaps: BANK-RURAL 1990-1994 through 2017-2019 are broad+orthogonal complete. TIME-2020-2022 broad recall is complete but one orthogonal challenge is required before the slice can close.

The 2020-2022 orthogonal challenge must test whether funding geography, internet/off-site deposits, sponsor/shareholder control, depositor-confidence failures and provincial support/resolution form a structural BANK-RURAL category or mainly an episodic village-bank tail. It should avoid simply repeating the broad pandemic-credit list.

Exact in-period provincial reform sequences, internet-deposit reliance by cohort, Henan village-bank actors/dates/amounts/legal findings, public-capital instruments and forbearance-to-recognition timing remain Evidence-stage questions.
Exact histories, event dates, actors, balances, ratios, ownership structures, sponsorship/restructuring terms, depositor amounts and official classifications remain Evidence-stage questions.
Evidence remains deferred while BANK-RURAL is unsealed.

next_probe.instruction: Run one isolated BANK-RURAL 2020-2022 orthogonal blind-memory challenge using only this rev162 compact map, the exhaustion manifest and current model internal memory/reasoning. Do not read blind-001 raw/receipt, any other completed Banking raw/receipts, Banking Evidence/source material or fresh Banking search. Do not re-run the broad pandemic-credit checklist. Instead test whether the remembered funding-geography / internet-or-off-site deposit / sponsor-and-shareholder-control / depositor-confidence / provincial-union-or-government-support / resolution cluster is genuinely structural across BANK-RURAL or mainly an episodic village-bank tail. Recover counterexamples where local deposit franchises, sponsor control, provincial shared services or county economics behaved differently; distinguish village banks from RCC/RCB lineage; separate shared IT/liquidity coordination from credit-loss mutualization; preserve uncertainty around the Henan village-bank episode and do not invent exact actors, dates, amounts or legal findings. Also challenge whether capital injections, mergers and stronger provincial integration were causes, responses or later developments rather than in-period structural facts. Preserve BANK-CITY, BANK-STATE-OWNED, SYS-REGULATION-RESOLUTION and asset-theme boundaries. Output MEMORY_LEADS_ONLY; append raw+receipt, rebuild exactly one sparse frontier, then close S -> cursor-only H -> exact-H CLEAN. If the orthogonal challenge finds no second period-wide structural category and mostly refines the broad map, mark TIME-2020-2022 broad+orthogonal complete and advance exactly one frontier to TIME-2023-2026 broad recall. If it remains materially novel, select only one further independent same-slice challenge rather than advancing prematurely.
